headline: Palo Alto Networks shares surge after beating Q1 forecasts and announcing a $4.5 billion acquisition of AI startup Applied Compute
IEA reports global cooling demand surpasses heating for first time, signalling a shift in energy use patterns
IEA estimates the Middle East war has removed 2.8 billion barrels of oil and 60 billion m³ of gas from global supply, warning demand could fall unless accelerated electrification continues.
